# Quickstart

Build a simple agent that submits a confidential text inference request and retrieves the result.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+ and npm
- Python 3.11+ (for backend examples)
- MetaMask with Arbitrum Sepolia testnet
- Sepolia ETH for gas

<Info>
  You can get Sepolia ETH from the [Arbitrum Sepolia faucet](https://faucet.quicknode.com/arbitrum/sepolia) or [Alchemy faucet](https://sepoliafaucet.com/).
</Info>

## Clone and Setup

```bash title="Clone repository and install dependencies"
git clone https://github.com/baync180705/blindference.git
cd blindference/network/packages/frontend
npm install
```

## Configure Environment

```bash title="Copy environment file"
cp .env.example .env
```

Edit `.env`:

```bash title="Frontend environment variables"
VITE_ICL_BASE_URL=https://icl.blindference.xyz
VITE_ARBITRUM_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL=https://arb-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY
VITE_CHAIN_ID=421614
VITE_WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID=your_project_id
VITE_BLINDFERENCE_AGENT_ADDRESS=0x43132afC4F163C244f7b66Adafee32F6B904994c
VITE_BLINDFERENCE_INPUT_VAULT_ADDRESS=0x8dD7B2A9B69C76A69d33B2DF46426Cbe657a902b
VITE_PROMPT_KEY_STORE_ADDRESS=0x1E22dD12f448B15f1Ca8560fB6B4463834FaAf73
VITE_PROMPT_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS=20000
VITE_IPFS_GATEWAY_URL=https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs
```

<Warning>
  Replace `YOUR_KEY` with a real Alchemy API key. The frontend, ICL, and each node should use **different dedicated keys** to avoid rate limiting.
</Warning>

## Start the Frontend

```bash title="Start development server"
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000 and connect MetaMask to Arbitrum Sepolia.

## Submit a Text Inference Request

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Using the UI">
    <Steps>
      <Step title="Open app" icon="globe">
        Navigate to the Blindference frontend
      </Step>
      <Step title="Create inference" icon="plus">
        Click "New Inference" in the sidebar
      </Step>
      <Step title="Enter prompt" icon="message-square">
        Enter a prompt (e.g., "Explain quantum computing in simple terms")
      </Step>
      <Step title="Select model" icon="brain">
        Choose a model: Groq Llama 3 or Google Gemini
      </Step>
      <Step title="Submit" icon="send">
        Click "Submit". MetaMask will prompt for:
        - `storeKey` transaction (stores CoFHE-encrypted AES key halves)
      </Step>
      <Step title="Wait for quorum" icon="clock">
        Wait for quorum execution (~30-60s)
      </Step>
      <Step title="Reveal answer" icon="eye">
        Click "Reveal Answer" to decrypt the result
      </Step>
    </Steps>
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Using the Agent SDK (Recommended)">
    The fastest way to run confidential inference from code:

    ```bash title="Install and run in one command"
    npm install -g @abhieren/blindference-agent
    blindference-agent infer --prompt "What is the capital of France?"
    ```

    Or use the SDK programmatically:

    ```typescript title="TypeScript SDK"
    import { BlindferenceAgent } from '@abhieren/blindference-agent'

    const agent = new BlindferenceAgent({
      privateKey: process.env.BLF_PRIVATE_KEY!,
      paymentServiceUrl: 'https://payment.blindference.xyz',
      rpcUrl: process.env.BLF_RPC_URL!
    })

    await agent.initCofhe()
    const result = await agent.infer({
      prompt: 'What is the capital of France?',
      modelId: 'groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile'
    })

    console.log(result.output) // "Paris"
    ```

    <Info>
      The Agent SDK handles encryption, submission, polling, and decryption automatically.
      See the [Agent SDK docs](/build/agent-sdk/installation) for full details.
    </Info>
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Using the API (Advanced)">
    ```python title="Submit inference via Python"
    import requests
    import json

    # 1. Encrypt prompt (browser-side, simplified)
    # In production, use @cofhe/sdk in browser
    encrypted_prompt = "encrypted_blob_base64..."
    aes_key_high = "0x..."  # CoFHE encrypted uint128
    aes_key_low = "0x..."   # CoFHE encrypted uint128

    # 2. Upload to IPFS
    ipfs_response = requests.post(
        "https://api.pinata.cloud/pinning/pinFileToIPFS",
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_PINATA_JWT"},
        files={"file": encrypted_prompt}
    )
    prompt_cid = ipfs_response.json()["IpfsHash"]

    # 3. Submit to ICL
    icl_response = requests.post(
        "https://icl.blindference.xyz/v1/inference/requests",
        json={
            "developer_address": "0xYourWalletAddress",
            "model_id": "groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
            "mode": "text",
            "text_request": {
                "prompt_cid": prompt_cid,
                "encrypted_prompt_key": {
                    "high": aes_key_high,
                    "low": aes_key_low
                },
                "model_id": "groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
                "coverage_enabled": False
            },
            "min_tier": 0,
            "verifier_count": 2
        }
    )

    request_id = icl_response.json()["job_id"]
    print(f"Request submitted: {request_id}")

    # 4. Poll for status
    import time
    while True:
        status = requests.get(
            f"https://icl.blindference.xyz/v1/inference/{request_id}"
        ).json()
        print(f"Status: {status['status']}")
        if status["status"] in ["ACCEPTED", "REJECTED"]:
            break
        time.sleep(5)

    # 5. Decrypt result (using CoFHE SDK in browser or node)
    # ... decrypt output key from PromptKeyStore, download output blob, AES decrypt
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Verify

Check the request status in the ICL:

```bash title="Check request status via API"
curl -s "https://icl.blindference.xyz/v1/inference/YOUR_REQUEST_ID" | python3 -m json.tool
```

Expected response:

```json title="Accepted inference response"
{
  "job_id": "...",
  "status": "ACCEPTED",
  "output_cid": "Qm...",
  "commitment_hash": "0x...",
  "quorum": {
    "verifier_addresses": ["0x...", "0x..."],
    "confirmations": 2,
    "confidence": 100
  }
}
```
